business_problem: consolidate dozens of disconnected data environments so teams could understand visitor journeys, operations, and sustainability performance and use agentic AI without growing the data team.
solution_summary: Red Sea Global uses Snowflake, Cortex AI, Streamlit, and Apache Iceberg on Snowflake to consolidate dozens of disconnected data environments so teams could understand visitor journeys, operations, and sustainability performance and use agentic AI without growing the data team. Guest, iot, sustainability, and operations data are centralized in Snowflake so resort, sustainability, and analytics teams can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. Cortex AI adds in-platform LLM and agentic capabilities for classification, summarization, retrieval, or natural-language analytics on top of the curated data foundation. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. Red Sea Global achieved 100s Of hours saved through Agentic AI and 50+ Data environments consolidated into one.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Provides the centralized data platform that stores governed datasets and serves analytics or AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Cortex AI
solution_components.role: Provides in-platform AI functions used for summarization, classification, generation, or model-assisted analysis.

solution_components.name: Streamlit
solution_components.role: Provides the user interface for analytics or AI applications backed by Snowflake data.

solution_components.name: Apache Iceberg
solution_components.role: Provides open table interoperability for shared data stored across the broader data ecosystem.
